name: Flinders Disability Scholarship
summary: $6,000 a year for up to four years for commencing undergraduates with an Access Plan and financial need.
key: Valued at $6,000 per year for up to four years.
who: Have an Access Plan registered with Health and Counselling services, or have requested one
Australian citizen, NZ citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder
Commencing an undergraduate degree, enrolled full-time
Be in receipt of means-tested government payments or be able to demonstrate financial hardship
how: Apply online through the Flinders University Student System by the closing date
catches: The 2026 round opened 15-12-2025 and closed 13-03-2026; check for the next round
